test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 17th November 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 5.
solution:
The correct answer is route.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• Route means a way or course taken in getting from a starting point to a destination.

 -Example: All lines of communication were routed through London.

Hence, the most appropriate option to fill in is 'Route'.

​Therefore, the correct answer is option 2.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• 'Track' means to follow the trail or movements of (someone or something), typically in order to find them or note their course.
 
• 'Path' means the course or direction in which a person or thing is moving.
 
• 'Road' means a wide way leading from one place to another, especially one with a specially prepared surface which vehicles can use.
